Method of Attack: zero-click, zero-day vulnerability enabling code execution and privilege escalation
installation through a malicious iMessage attachment
exfiltration of private data including microphone recordings, instant messenger photos, geolocation information, and other sensitive activities
Impacted Systems: iPhones running iOS versions prior to 15.7
Attack Vector: malicious iMessage containing an attachment housing the exploit
Indicators of Compromise: root privilege payload executing commands to collect system and user information
